title: Scannable QR code
notes: The QR payload travels in params.extra_texts with reference "qr_code"; params.workflow selects the QR ControlNet workflow. High-contrast, geometric prompts scan far more reliably than soft or low-contrast ones, which is why this is pinned to world 1: the skyharbor seen from above is a grid of bright decking and black gaps, and the anime and garden worlds have no equally geometric view. The sampler, guidance, step count, karras setting and control strength are the recipe that was scan-tested during review rather than the anchor's defaults: a code that does not scan is not a worked example of anything.
